tools.name: describe_platform
tools.description: Describes PreShiftIQ and how its vendor matching works. Use this when a user asks what PreShiftIQ is or how it matches the client, the company evaluating technology, with supply chain technology vendors. Returns the platform description and the URL to start an assessment. It covers transportation ma

tools.name: list_verticals
tools.description: Lists the technology categories PreShiftIQ covers, each with its live covered-vendor count and the URL of its page for clients. Counts come from the live catalog reader, the same one the public site reads. Use this when a user asks what PreShiftIQ covers.

tools.name: get_public_catalog
tools.description: Lists the vendors PreShiftIQ covers in one vertical, alphabetically, as catalog coverage only, with no participation status; the matches of the client (the evaluating company) come from their own completed assessment. Use this when a user asks which vendors PreShiftIQ covers or whether a named vendo

tools.name: explain_matching
tools.description: Explains how PreShiftIQ computes matches: disqualification first, then measured-fit scoring, with every match recorded immutably. Includes the live tier thresholds and the fit-index note. Use this when a user asks how matches are computed or what a match score means.

tools.name: how_we_are_paid
tools.description: States how PreShiftIQ is paid. Use this when a user asks about cost, fees, or independence.

tools.name: start_assessment
tools.description: Returns the URL the client (the evaluating company) opens to start their operational assessment for a chosen technology category. The URL is opened by the user; this tool writes nothing itself. If no category is given, the tool asks the user to choose one.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches what PreShiftIQ publishes: the platform's own description, the published answers for clients in each covered category, and the catalog of covered vendors. Returns matching documents by id, in a fixed order; nothing is ranked.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns one published PreShiftIQ document by the id search returned: its title, its text and its URL.

tools.name: my_assessment_status
tools.description: For the signed-in client (the evaluating company): whether the latest completed PreShiftIQ assessment has results, whether those results are under review, how many matched vendors were notified, how many have accepted, and how many matches are still queued for delivery. tools.name: my_matches
tools.description: For the signed-in client (the evaluating company): the notified matches of the latest completed assessment, or of the assessment named by assessment_id, best score first, each as a masked card with its score and tier. tools.name: my_scorecard_status
tools.description: For the signed-in vendor: the scorecard's status and completion, and its lead counts (pending, accepted, declined, expiring soon). findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "describe_platform" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
